title: Dispatch: 19.4.2 creature attack grammar repairs (attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-o9bd.19.4.2 exactly per its DESIGN field (C1-C3, representation decision, F-31 check, CAP-004, cross-kind siblings, registry, evidence). Importer work: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (no hand edits; regenerate with npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 plus the default .generated run; npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack must exit 0; regenerate docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md} with npx tsx packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts if its test requires it). Validate the new alternatives field in packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts (fail closed: condition non-empty string, hitDamage non-empty array of the existing damage shape, optional integer attackBonus). Before changing anything, grep packages/core/src for consumers of creature attacks/hitDamage/mechanics.damage and report them; if a deterministic consumer exists, stop and report.
Diff records.json after regeneration: every changed record must be in the C1/C2/C3 populations (by query) or a listed cross-kind sibling; list each with before/after. Any other churn: stop and report.
HARD STOP: If the failure map reveals a new root cause, requires a new parser or extractor strategy, or creates generated churn outside the direct consequences of the current minimal fix, stop and report instead of broadening the implementation. Do not add complexity solely to suppress source-confirmed incidental improvements caused by the correct fix.
Also append the F-27 coordination sentence to eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1 with bd update --append-notes.
REPORT (bd notes): consumers found, changed records with before/after, cross-kind sibling dispositions, signed-number grammar siblings fixed, existing test changes with rationale, commands and results.
notes:
COMPLETION REPORT (commit bfa838c2 on eshyra-o9bd.19.4.2.1, not pushed).
CONSUMERS: grep of packages/core/src and packages/cli/src found no deterministic consumer of attacks[]/hitDamage/mechanics.damage for creatures. Only kindSchemas validation, deep-audit-dnd5e-srd/cli.ts (audit read of mechanics.attacks), and the projection code. Summoning attack shape (summoningSchema) is separate. HARD STOP not triggered.
CHANGES: mechanicsProjections.ts (DAMAGE_TERM_RE U+2212; ATTACK_CLAUSE_RE with optional mode bonus; projectHitDamage: alternatives via 'or' / comma-only leads, plus-riders shared by all modes; projectEntryDamage for top-level default; ATTACK_RANGE_RE for N ft./M ft., ranged N/M, single range N; signed-number siblings at attack/damage/check/AC bonus, healing dice). kindSchemas.ts: validateAttackAlternatives (condition non-empty, hitDamage non-empty with validateDamageEntry, optional integer attackBonus). Pack regenerated via import:dnd5e-srd (canonical + default .generated). Only records.json changed in the pack.
CHANGED RECORDS (34, all in populations): C1 baboon, awakened-shrub, giant-fire-beetle; C2 druid, dryad; C3 azer, bugbear, drider, duergar, erinyes, gladiator, gnoll, guard, half-red-dragon-veteran, hobgoblin, merfolk, oni, sahuagin, salamander, swarm-of-bats, swarm-of-insects, swarm-of-poisonous-snakes, swarm-of-quippers, swarm-of-rats, swarm-of-ravens, tribal-warrior, veteran, werewolf, wight; F-31 bandit, barbed-devil, efreeti, horned-devil, salamander, scout. No removed/added keys.
EXAMPLES before->after: druid Quarterstaff attacks absent -> default [1d6 bludgeoning], alternatives [if wielded with two hands: 1d8], [with shillelagh: 1d8+2, attackBonus 4]; top damage 3 cumulative -> [1d6]. dryad Club attacks absent -> [2 (1d4)], alt [with shillelagh: 1d8+4, attackBonus 6]. drider Longsword hitDamage [1d8+3, 1d10+3] -> [1d8+3] + alt [if used with two hands: 1d10+3]. azer Warhammer [1d8+3 bludg, 1d10+3 bludg, 1d6 fire] -> [1d8+3, 1d6 fire] + alt [if used with two hands...: 1d10+3, 1d6 fire]. baboon Bite hitDamage absent -> [1d4 - 1 piercing]. bandit rangeFeet absent -> {normal 80, long 320}; scout absent -> {150,600}; salamander absent -> {20,60}; efreeti/barbed-devil/horned-devil absent -> {normal 120|150}.
SIBLINGS: magic-item deck-of-illusions, ioun-stone, ring-of-spell-storing U+2212 are random counts, not dice damage: unchanged, nothing lost. creature hit-point formulas (bat, frog, rat, spider, kobold, swarms etc.) are hitPoints text, unchanged. Spell/equipment/hazard: no U+2212 dice, no mode-bonus or 'or N (XdY)' forms.
DEVIATIONS FROM DESIGN: (1) F-31 premise was false: six ranged attacks had lost rangeFeet; repaired in the same parser (regex generalization, no new strategy). (2) Shared riders repeat in every mode by design, so 'exactly once across hitDamage+alternatives' was tested as union equality + default-first. (3) Dryad shillelagh bonus is +6 in source (design said +4); used source. (4) single 'range N ft.' projects {normal:N} with no long key. (5) Comma-only lead (druid) recognized as an alternative; only corpus instance.
TESTS: existing test change: findingRegistry.test.ts reasoning-row count 9->13 and narrowed list adds creature-statblock-mechanics (registry rows changed as designed). Others pass unchanged. New file packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/creatureAttackGrammar.test.ts (5 tests: invariant, no-U+2212 + hitDamage, exact fidelity, ranged notation, fail-closed schema).
REGISTRY: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json: druid-dryad-attacks, unicode-minus-damage, ranged-notation stay accepted with statusReasoning naming this repair; creature-statblock-mechanics accepted->narrowed (ADR 0020).
